In this mythical world the apex predator is this thing called a "titan", which is basically a mindless humanoid beast that runs around eating any living thing it can stick in to its mouth. Nobody knows where they come from (although the story does eventually get in to that). Titans have no known means of reproduction.

They come in many different sizes from very small (3 meters or just under 10 feet tall) to extremely large (15+ meters or just under 50 feet tall) and tend to slowly evaporate in to steam when killed which is achieved by severing the spinal cord at the back of the neck. They've essentially pushed humanity back to a single city that is defended by a series of layered walls.

The movement equipment the warriors wear is called 3 dimensional maneuvering gear, and operates on a finite supply of compressed gas. The suit can fire omni-directional gappling hook and tow cables in multiple directions at the same time allowing for agile, acrobatic movement in areas with lots of grapple targets such as buildings or trees. Think steampunk spiderman. Each warrior carries spare blades for his two swords at his hip. The hilts have a quick release mechanism which allow a broken blade to easily be discarded and a new blade loaded as they are expected to be broken or go dull in combat.

The show has a pretty good premise and some interesting plot twists, but like all anime, it gets completely ruined by too much idiotic inner dialog scenes and stupid over the top emotional moments. The Japanese seem to love this shit and have no sense of moderation. A few of the characters seem to do nothing but cry 90% of the time when the action gets going.

Hopefully the game does better.
